stem: Nordlicht Freight's operations team provisions 40 resources that have no dependencies on each other. They want the ones with no relationship to run at the same time, without anyone hand-ordering the steps. Which capability provides that?

choices.text: A script that lists all 40 resources in a fixed order, run top to bottom.
Split the 40 resources across several scripts that run at the same time, with an engineer deciding which resources go in which script.
A dependency graph that starts each resource as soon as its own prerequisites finish, so resources with no dependency between them run at the same time.
A configuration-management tool that converges each server's settings on its own recurring schedule, independent of how the servers were originally provisioned.

rationale: The key describes Terraform's resource graph, which walks a node as soon as its own dependencies are finished, so independent resources proceed together automatically. A script written in a fixed order runs strictly serially by construction, even for resources with no relationship. Splitting the resources across scripts that run at the same time does produce parallelism, but a person has to decide the split, which is the hand-ordering the team wants to avoid. A configuration-management tool converges settings on servers that already exist on its own schedule; it does not address how those 40 resources get provisioned or ordered in the first place.
